optimizedDescription.value: Backend-neutral durable graph port with recovery, atomic generations, filtered impact, exact batches, and indexed search.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph Store

## Rules
- Abstract `GraphStore(storagePath)` port in `domain/ports/`; concrete infrastructure owns schema/layout/backend.
- Persist Files (canonical/project-relative paths, content, category `source|test|ignored`), Symbols, Specs, Documents, all relation families, statistics, VCS ref, derivation fingerprint, generation, observations, coverage/reference facts.
- `open()` explicit and non-destructive; corruption/incompatibility returns typed recoverable open error. `close()` idempotent and leaves closed after partial failure.
- `recreate()` requires closed store, physically replaces persistence, rotates generation, remains closed. `clear()` requires healthy open store, removes every logical artifact/index/observation/fingerprint/ref influencing next index, preserves physical generation.
- Providers cache generation at open and detect external destructive replacement before reads.
- `upsertFile(file,symbols,relations)` atomically replaces one file slice; failure preserves previous state. `addRelations` additive. `removeFile` atomically removes file, symbols, endpoint relations.
- File content and category persist/index; category defaults `source`.
- Query contract covers individual/batch/all node retrieval; symbol/file/spec dependency, hierarchy, import, coverage reads; symbol queries by name/kind/file/comment/category.
- Exact batches `getSymbolsByIds`, `getFilesByPaths`, `getDocumentsByPaths`, `getSpecsByIds`: arbitrary input order, dedupe first occurrence, omit missing, preserve requested order, empty input avoids backend work, no call per identity.
- Batch incoming/outgoing symbol relations accept IDs+types, support dependency/hierarchy families, deterministic source/type/target order, dedupe, omit unknown, empty avoids work, logical batch not per ID/type.
- Filtered-impact input carries result types, kinds, workspace inclusion/exclusion, category admission, target, direction, resource category, depth. Categories default source; exclusions win; empty inclusion admits all; depth zero supports coverage.
- Backend applies supported relation/kind/category/workspace predicates during physical query; never return unrestricted candidates for TypeScript post-filtering. Worker/batch protocol preserves filters.
- Coverage reverse lookups batch file paths/logical symbol IDs. `COVERS_SYMBOL` targets logical symbols and rejects absent endpoints.
- Member lookups use structured workspace/surface/name/space/owner/`MemberSemantics`; owned symbols support exact `qualified_name`; no FTS or alias rows for qualified names.
- Source-content search operates on persisted `FileNode.content`, substring-capable for ≥3 chars with bounded fallback.
- Search symbols/specs/documents prioritizes exact primary identity before ranked normalized text/comment/content. Rebuild hook supports explicit FTS maintenance.
- Statistics expose node counts, per-`RelationType` counts, languages, last index time/ref, fingerprint.
- Spec upsert/removal atomically replaces spec-owned dependencies/coverage as defined.
- Indexed observations and stale latches update atomically and monotonically; complete generation may clear latches.
- Bulk indexing uses one chunked session, one commit, bounded writes, optional final search rebuild.

## Constraints
- Abstract class, not interface; backend-neutral contract.
- Closed operations raise `StoreNotOpenError`.
- File-level/logical-generation mutations atomic.
- No direct `@specd/core` dependency; package errors use code-graph error hierarchy.
- No prescribed storage engine, schema, tables, worker messages, or filenames.
